body:
Draft B after your change ("the limit is 1000, and a rejected order goes back to the cart"):

B: approval only above a limit
- added: decision "Total above 1000?", "Approve order" on its yes branch
- added: "Return to cart" on the rejected branch of "Approve order"
- touched: checkout

Draft A is still on disk; ask for it to see it again.

questions.question: Confirm draft B, change it again, or drop the drafts?

options.label: Confirm draft B
options.description: A revision is saved, draft B is written to the run and every output is rebuilt and reviewed

options.label: Show draft A again
options.description: The other draft, as it was presented

options.label: Drop all drafts
options.description: The run stays as it is
